strata.selection_rule: Select the first fresh paired task identities in lexicographic order after excluding every TG4 and TG6-v4 identity.
Within each family and split, select the first fresh paired task identities in lexicographic order after excluding every TG4 and TG6-v4 identity.

conditions.description: Use the current first-eligible admissible action rule exactly as exercised by TG6 v4.
Use historical_actions and observable-state fingerprints to penalize repeated recent action-state cycles while preserving admissibility.
After cycle detection, use only observation, historical_actions, and admissible_actions to prefer observable novelty and skill/edge changes while preserving admissibility.

stop_rule: stop on first hard invariant violation
paired_seed_rule: Use one fixed seed per development task and reuse that seed across all three conditions.

analysis_strata.reporting_rule: Report every metric overall and separately by stratum, task family, split, and condition; do not pool family effects into a single causal claim without the stratum breakdown.

decision_gate.mechanism_positive: On the primary direct-cycle stratum, at least one trajectory ablation reduces two_cycle_rate by at least 50% relative to baseline; across all 24 paired tasks it does not exceed 25% abstention, preserves 100% trace validity, and gains at least 2 paired successes over baseline.
decision_gate.observability_limited: On the primary direct-cycle stratum, at least one trajectory ablation reduces two_cycle_rate by at least 50%, but neither ablation reaches more than 1/24 total successes and the post-hoc indistinguishable-goal audit finds an allowed-input equivalence class with conflicting goals.
decision_gate.negative: Neither trajectory ablation reduces primary-stratum two_cycle_rate by at least 50%, or any condition violates admissibility, trace completeness, or runtime input isolation.
decision_gate.inconclusive: The results satisfy none of the predeclared positive, observability-limited, or negative rules.

identifiability_audit.purpose: Check whether identical allowed-input histories can correspond to conflicting task goals without feeding goal metadata into any runtime condition.
